approach: Implement main(api) using five helpers: observe, fit_candidates, lease, verify_effect, recover. Phases are identify bowl/plate, measure local geometry, select rim pinch, approach, close, test retention, transport, lower, release, withdraw, and verify support. The supplied views suggest a rim pinch, not an assumed diameter grasp; all geometry is acquired afresh. Use geo helpers and api.drive leases of at most eight updates, switching to individual api.control calls when features need refreshing. Checkpoint phase intent before intervention and acknowledged jaw transitions immediately afterward. Four bounded records, each below 8 KB, retain identities, geometry, tracker provenance, counters and receipts; diagnostics use a twelve-entry window. Return completion_proposed and measured evidence, not a claim of native evaluator success.
observations: Use api.state and fresh api.review with declared fields, explicit unknown values, semantic landmark definitions, and requests within 32 points/eight regions. Request visible bowl rim/wall, plate rim/bed, tabletop samples and textured interior patch polygons. Separate same-body identity, correspondence ambiguity, visible obstruction and incomplete visibility. Inspect measurement_errors before indexing. Validate interior depth and model residuals; use api.plane_point only for visibly identified boundaries on a measured plane. Use geo.plane coefficients and geo.circle_xy with horizontal-plane and angular-coverage checks. Initialize api.track_init before closure where possible; save patch-to-envelope relations and any bottom-height inference from observed tabletop support. Validate every track_update using frame_id, reference_frame_id, inliers, spread and uncertainty_floor_m. Motion invalidates affected geometry; unknown tracking supplies no transform. Retain finite correspondence hypotheses rather than inventing hidden corners.
geometry: Model the upright bowl and plate as circular only when measured geometry supports it; otherwise request relevant local measurements. Derive finger envelopes from own_geometry, qpos and geo.rotation/pad_position. Search up to eight observable rim sectors, three depths spanning feasible intervals, and five plate offsets derived from receiving-area slack. Intersect jaw opening, inner-finger floor clearance, outer-finger tabletop clearance and contact-band overlap constraints. For translated intervals, positive overlap m requires c+m-b <= t <= d-m-a and 0<m<=min(b-a,d-c); band centers need not lie inside the wall band. Report nominal slack separately from worst-case slack over componentwise uncertainties and supported symmetries, preserving shared-plane correlations. Residual-derived bounds are heuristic, not calibrated guarantees. Use measured bowl envelope, plate support region and local obstacle heights for staged transfer. Select legal controller tolerances from effect slack; if deadband limits correction, use a justified bounded trial and remeasure rather than repeat unchanged commands.
gate_dependencies: Approach needs identifiable local wall geometry and no observed obstruction to that local action, not certification of the entire transfer. Closure needs feasible finger placement and fresh relative alignment. A small lift needs a justified local envelope and an obtainable object reference, not already-proven retention. Retention requires independent object motion compared with measured hand motion using geo.attachment_error; jaw delivery alone is insufficient. A new identified patch can establish this differential witness without old vertex registration. Transfer additionally needs its relation to the transported envelope, reacquired if necessary. Lowering needs current bowl/plate geometry. Release follows measured placement height and footprint. Completion requires open-jaw delivery, hand withdrawal, and independent observations showing the bowl stable on and supported by the plate, not following the hand.
bounded_recovery: Every observer returns adequate, contradicted or unknown; all callers, including post-lift and post-release, enter the same bounded recovery dispatcher. Allow at most three distinct informative alternatives per predicate: another visible region/camera, semantically corresponding landmarks or a new patch reference, and a locally justified view/probe action. Unchanged occluded reviews do not count as new evidence. Observed obstruction rejects that action; unknown visibility is not certified clearance. Failed conservative slack triggers candidate search or relevant sensing before any justified trial. Limit grasp attempts to two and pre-release placement correction to one. Keep possible-held state after missing evidence; retry grasp only after verified return to support and release. Post-release uncertainty never triggers automatic regrasp. Reserve 40 Jev calls/six reviews for recovery and 20/two for finalization, within current budgets. Recompute route-call needs when shortening legs. Distinguish observed loss, inconclusive evidence, resource exhaustion and programming/API errors.
jev_contract: Send program-derived candidate geometry, slack components, uncertainties, obstruction evidence, phase and provenance as features. Optional api.choose selects among at most eight explicitly described enabled candidates; it receives structured features, not images or executable Python. Invalid/ineligible selections terminate that branch rather than authorize motion. Every physical update uses real api.control or api.drive with exactly x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,gripper questions. Each axis question explicitly names its world-coordinate or world-rotation subject: negative decreases, hold requests zero, positive increases; gripper choices mean open, close or keep. Jev answers are dispatched unchanged. Inspect choices, acknowledged_steps and receipts, then api.state for full proprioception; receipt before/after are TCP vectors. Save pre-lease state for whole-lease comparisons. Command acknowledgment and reached status establish delivery/pose only. Independently remeasure retention, placement and final support; log numerical margins and discrepancies before later observations can fail.
